contradictions.what: Rep says 'we were the favourite' and Ben had the team planning integration, but Halima, not Ben, made the call in one meeting.
Rep thought the load test had won it, but Halima's only response was 'good' and she says she doesn't buy uptime.
Rep says we were the better platform, but the customer judged on who picks up, and Halima called our support a queue with a faster timer.
Rep asserts the competitor over-promised, then admits 'I don't know that'.
Rep says we don't have an on-sale plan, then says they could have built one with the solutions engineer.

outcome_signals.what: Lost: Ben told the rep he lost, and Halima made the call.
Customer was replacing payments and chose the competitor over us; the rep places the turning point at Halima's 'queue with a faster timer' remark.
The CTO and technical team preferred us, yet the deal was still lost. The transcript does not say whether only part of the business moved.
